Name: (SHOP) The Voidwitch's Familiar
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
[quote][i]You've done quite a few feats in the valley, getting your grandpa's farm back into it's old glory, doing work for the community...one day among many, just like any other though, a letter reaches you from an unknown sender.

In it you're informed that someone will visit your valley, bringing certain goods...his name is Faust and he-...is unlike anything you've seen before. Will you risk it and buy from him?[/i][/quote]
Adds a new shop after you finished the community center(alternatively: if you get the warehouse cutscene too) that is centered around selling 21 fall seeds, 33 new dishes,1 scarecrow and 5 forage items. Adds an NPC and a new little area where you can find the forage.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Future content will include ways to do more with the forage, fish and a few other things.[/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][b]Fausts favorite things are related to the void.[/b] His "loves" are solely that. I can't stop other mods from adding universal loves etc. but anything that I do not mention on the mod page do not count lore-wise(think of it more as the other mod authors head canons or w/e). That's why I highly suggest playing with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50533]Universal Loves Begone[/url] which gets rid of the universal gift tastes(or just leaves the vanilla ones via config).[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b]Loves[/b]: void egg, void mayo, void salmon, void essence, galaxy soul
  [b]Likes[/b]: prismatic shard, monster musk, strange bun, magic rock candy, star shard, solar essence
He is mostly neutral to anything else.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI, Content Patcher, Spacecore and MMAP.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
[/center]
[center]Compatible with Overgrown Valley( unsure if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE [/url] but let me know if it is lol)!
